description: Small fixed public digital-paper corpus; local PDFs and real translations are supplied explicitly. This is not a representative semantic acceptance benchmark.

cases.title: Scikit-learn: Machine Learning in Python
cases.license: CC BY under JMLR author policy; PDF license version unspecified
focus: reading order and embedded target fonts

manual_checks.focus: Compare introduction claims and qualifications against the real source.
Check algorithm/API names and technical meaning without invented additions.
Visually inspect table labels, column order, clipping and legibility.
Visually confirm bibliography and URLs remain readable and unchanged.
